fields.name: value
fields.label: Geometry model
fields.hint: Selects the model that constructs the geometry. Pixal3D uses estimated camera intrinsics.

fields.name: width
fields.label: Width
fields.hint: Output width in pixels.

fields.name: height
fields.label: Height
fields.hint: Output height in pixels.

fields.name: pad_factor
fields.label: Crop margin
fields.hint: Scales the square crop around the subject before image conditioning.

fields.name: grow_mask
fields.label: Grow Mask
fields.hint: Grow or shrink the mask by this many pixels before cropping.

fields.name: background
fields.label: Background
fields.hint: Background colour outside the segmented subject.

fields.name: bg_removal_name
fields.label: Bg Removal Name
fields.hint: The model used to remove backgrounds from images

fields.name: resolution_level
fields.label: Resolution Level
fields.hint: 0 = fastest, 9 = most detail.

fields.name: fov_x_degrees
fields.label: FOV X Degrees
fields.hint: Horizontal field of view of the source camera. Sets the focal length used to unproject the depth map into 3D. 0 = auto-recover from the predicted points.

fields.name: batch_size
fields.label: Batch Size
fields.hint: Images per inference call. Lower if you OOM on a long video / image set.

fields.name: force_projection
fields.label: Force projection
fields.hint: Uses the estimated camera to project the reconstructed reference points.

fields.name: apply_mask
fields.label: Apply Mask
fields.hint: Set masked-out (sky / invalid) pixels to inf in points and depth so meshing culls them. Disable to keep the raw predicted geometry everywhere; the mask is still returned separately.

fields.name: refine_steps
fields.label: Refine Steps
fields.hint: MoGe-3 only: sparse volumetric refinement passes over the predicted depth. More passes sharpen fine detail and edges at a roughly linear cost. 0 disables refinement. Ignored by MoGe-1 / MoGe-2.

fields.name: axis
fields.label: Axis
fields.hint: 'vertical' (fov_y), 'horizontal' (fov_x), or 'diagonal'.

fields.name: unit
fields.label: Unit
fields.hint: Output unit for the FOV.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Seed
fields.hint: The random seed used for creating the noise.

fields.name: steps
fields.label: Steps
fields.hint: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

fields.name: cfg
fields.label: Guidance (CFG)
fields.hint: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

fields.name: sampler_name
fields.label: Sampler Name
fields.hint: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

fields.name: scheduler
fields.label: Scheduler
fields.hint: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

fields.name: denoise
fields.label: Denoise
fields.hint: Samples the tail of the noise schedule. Full denoise uses all steps from the reference recipe.

fields.name: batch_size
fields.label: Batch Size
fields.hint: The number of latent images in the batch.

fields.name: target_resolution
fields.label: Target Resolution
fields.hint: Voxel resolution of the upsampled shape. Higher = more detail, more VRAM.

fields.name: remove_floaters
fields.label: Remove Floaters
fields.hint: Removes small disconnected components after reconstruction.

fields.name: remove_inner_faces
fields.label: Remove Inner Faces
fields.hint: Drops duplicate interior faces from the reconstructed surface.

fields.name: seal_max_steps
fields.label: Seal Max Steps
fields.hint: Sets the number of sampling steps in this stage.

fields.name: seal_max_steps
fields.label: Seal Max Steps
fields.hint: Sets the number of sampling steps in this stage.

fields.name: segmenter
fields.label: Segmenter
fields.hint: pec: fast parallel-edge-collapse charting on GPU. adaptive: CPU, slower.

fields.name: resolution
fields.label: Resolution
fields.hint: Target atlas resolution for texel-density auto-scale (0 = fit-to-content).

fields.name: padding
fields.label: Island padding
fields.hint: Keeps space between adjacent UV islands.

fields.name: weld_distance
fields.label: Weld Distance
fields.hint: Coincident-vert merge radius as a fraction of mesh extent (0 = auto). Raise to ~0.001 if you get per-triangle charts (unwelded input).

fields.name: crease_angle
fields.label: Crease Angle
fields.hint: Edges whose dihedral angle exceeds this value (degrees) stay hard (vertices are split). 180 = fully smooth; lower preserves sharp edges (e.g. ~30-60 for hard-surface).

fields.name: brighter
fields.label: Brighter
fields.hint: Applies a mild uniform brightness boost to the baked base color map

fields.name: bg_removal_name
fields.label: Bg Removal Name
fields.hint: The model used to remove backgrounds from images

fields.name: padding
fields.label: Padding
fields.hint: Adds a margin during this stage.

fields.name: mask_polarity
fields.label: Mask Polarity
fields.hint: BiRefNet foreground mask: foreground. Load Image MASK: background.

fields.name: normal_view_resolution
fields.label: Normal View Resolution
fields.hint: Actual mesh normal/depth render size. Images are disk-cached; only a 512 preview goes to UI.

fields.name: camera_fit
fields.label: Camera Fit
fields.hint: native_mesh_fit = ORIGINAL v0.4.2 auto_fit_94 cameras (safe shared fit); custom adjusts camera margins; NO image crop.

fields.name: image_margin_percent
fields.label: Image Margin Percent
fields.hint: Custom camera fit only: percent border EACH image side; not UV padding.

fields.name: image_padding_pixels
fields.label: Image Padding Pixels
fields.hint: Custom camera fit only: extra pixel safety border EACH image side; not UV padding.

fields.name: reference_zoom
fields.label: Reference zoom
fields.hint: Scales the reference inside the texture camera framing.

fields.name: view_resolution
fields.label: View Resolution
fields.hint: Must match the resolution chosen in Prepare.

fields.name: view_count
fields.label: Number of views
fields.hint: Must match the view count chosen in Prepare.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Seed
fields.hint: Controls random sampling in this stage. Keep it fixed when comparing another setting.

fields.name: steps
fields.label: Steps
fields.hint: Sets the number of sampling steps in this stage.

fields.name: guidance
fields.label: Guidance
fields.hint: CFG scale: active only when a different negative CONDITIONING is connected. With no negative input, it does not change sampling.

fields.name: sparse_retention
fields.label: Sparse Retention
fields.hint: Lower is lighter/faster; higher keeps more tokens in sparse attention.

fields.name: extra_angle_mode
fields.label: Extra Angle Mode
fields.hint: For 10 or 12 views, use the first pass to guide the 45-degree pass. 10 views omits redundant rotated top/bottom.

fields.name: extra_denoise
fields.label: Extra Denoise
fields.hint: How freely the guided 45-degree pass can change already observed details.

fields.name: extra_steps
fields.label: Extra Steps
fields.hint: Separate iteration budget for the 45-degree pass.

fields.name: tiled_decode
fields.label: Tiled Decode
fields.hint: Tiled VAE for limited VRAM. Disable only if the VAE can decode without OOM.

fields.name: view_resolution

fields.hint: Must match the resolution chosen in Prepare.

fields.name: view_count

fields.hint: Tiled VAE for limited VRAM. Disable only if the VAE can decode without OOM.

fields.name: texture_size
fields.label: Texture Size
fields.hint: Final exported atlas size. UTX2.5 target changes source views only. 8192 requires a sharp mode and takes more bake time and RAM.

fields.name: completion
fields.label: Completion
fields.hint: surface_fill: texels no camera saw are completed along the mesh surface (seamless across UV seams, never copied from unrelated UV islands). off: leave unseen Base Color black to inspect raw camera coverage (unseen MR becomes a neutral rough dielectric).

fields.name: upscale_mode
fields.label: Atlas upscaling
fields.hint: Controls how samples from the generated views are filtered into the texture atlas.

fields.name: system_headroom_mb
fields.label: System Headroom Mb
fields.hint: RAM-cache trimming target, not a required extra 2 GiB allocation.

fields.name: token_chunk
fields.label: Token Chunk
fields.hint: 0 disables chunking. Smaller chunks can repeat GGUF dequantization; benchmark before tuning.

fields.name: activation_factor
fields.label: Activation Factor
fields.hint: Conservative initial activation estimate. Calibrate against measured GPU peaks.

fields.name: max_vram_mb
fields.label: Max Vram Mb
fields.hint: 0: driver/physical budget. A lower limit also reduces packed-weight residency.
